policy: Fit causal FIR on the first 4 s of known panel-only audio using double precision CUDA ridge regression; validate on the next 750 ms at RMS >=64 and explained energy >=80%. Only after validation enable the residual wake route. Cold prefixes are silence, warm prefixes are the original microphone. Oracle uses the paired clean external track only as a diagnostic. All runs retain raw C161. Notification and two-second full-suffix ASR use sample clocks without DSP/verification execution time or Opus. Static synthetic path and synced reference.
